title: Big tree
content: At the very end of my dream as far (right?) As u can go in the farthest corner there’s a giant tree. I’ve been here a lot in my dreams and it’s a average part of my mall world dream. By giant I mean like world tree type. You can climb to the very top and I think usually it’s safe up there but it has a path to the top. Just was wondering if anyone else has this in their mall world dream.
